home.contactText: Have questions or need more information? Don't hesitate to contact us!
home.conandDescription: CONAND (Conference Andorra) is Andorra's tech conference, organized by the community, for the community. We bring together professionals, students and tech enthusiasts through meetups, workshops and an annual conference to share knowledge, build connections and boost the local tech ecosystem.
home.gdgDescription: CONAND is the official Google Developer Group (GDG) of Andorra. GDGs are local developer communities that meet to learn, share and grow together with Google technologies and beyond. Join our community!

aiChallenge.title: AI Counter Challenge
aiChallenge.subtitle: How many times will "AI" or "Artificial Intelligence" be said during the whole event?
aiChallenge.description: Guess the total number of mentions of "AI", "IA" or "Artificial Intelligence" throughout the event, and also the count per talk. You only get **one shot per user**: once submitted, your guess is locked and cannot be changed — so think it through. The window to participate closes at 23:59 on the day of the event.
aiChallenge.prizeNotice: There is a prize for the person who gets closest to the real count. Once we (or our AI agent 🤖) have done the final count, we'll email you if you've won.
aiChallenge.rule1: Spoken mentions of "AI", "IA" or "Artificial Intelligence" count (in any language).
aiChallenge.rule2: You must sign in with Google to participate.
aiChallenge.rule3: One guess per user. Once submitted, it's locked and cannot be changed.
aiChallenge.rule4: The winner is decided by proximity to the actual total count and is notified by email.
aiChallenge.challengeClosed: The deadline for guesses has passed. We'll publish the final count and notify the winner soon.
aiChallenge.signInDescription: We need to identify you to record your guess and contact you if you win.
aiChallenge.totalGuessHelp: Total times "AI" / "Artificial Intelligence" will be said during the whole event
aiChallenge.perTalkHelp: How many mentions in each talk (optional but recommended)
aiChallenge.errorSaving: There was an error saving your guess. Please try again.
aiChallenge.errorSignIn: Sign in failed. Please try again.
aiChallenge.alreadyGuessed: You've already submitted your guess. It's locked and can't be changed. Good luck! 🎲
aiChallenge.noActiveEvent: There is no active event for the challenge yet. Check back later!
